data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 85.354m. During 2014 the syndicate experienced a small net favourable run-off deviation of GBP 1.274m (release), driven by mixed developments in motor lines: a favourable movement in Motor (third party liability) of GBP 6.177m offset by adverse development in Motor (other classes) of GBP 4.856m (and a small adverse movement on reinsurance inwards of GBP 0.047m). The net effect was a modest release of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within the claims outstanding at 31 December 2014 is an Unexpired Risk Reserve of GBP 2.1m (31 December 2013: GBP 0.3m).
A favourable/(adverse) run-off deviation was experienced during the year in respect of the following classes of business:
a deterioration of GBP 2.1m in respect of two large incurred claims during the year and a generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development derived from the 'favourable/(adverse) run-off deviation' table (gross figures in GBP 7000). Positive numbers in that table were interpreted as favourable (releases) and parenthesised numbers as adverse (strengthenings). Prior year development reported as a net release of GBP 1.274m. Opening reserves taken from balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' (2013 comparative). No claims development triangle was present in the notes.
